title: TallyPrime Full Software Replication Specification & Technical Implementation Plan

executive_summary.philosophy: Power of Simplicity - 100% keyboard-first, zero latency, instantaneous screen switching (<10ms), real-time continuous double-entry ledger balancing with zero batch posting or closing locks, non-relational hierarchical object store, and universal non-destructive recursive drill-down.
core_differentiators: Pure keyboard navigation: Every action is accessible via single hotkeys, Tab, Enter, Esc, and Alt/Ctrl combinations.
Zero-latency state preservation: Pressing Alt+G (Go To) mid-voucher allows exploring any report or master, and pressing Esc returns immediately to the exact cursor position in the in-flight voucher.
Real-time ledger recalculation: Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss, Trial Balance, Stock Summary, and Outstandings update synchronously on every voucher save.

Universal drill-down recursion: Pressing Enter on any financial number recursively drills down from Primary Group -> Subgroup -> Ledger -> Monthly Summary -> Voucher Register -> Specific Voucher in edit mode.
Integrated Accounting + Inventory + Statutory + Payroll + Banking: A single cohesive object model rather than fragmented relational database modules.

proposed_modern_tech_stack.backend_core: Rust (Memory-safe, zero-cost abstractions, deterministic sub-millisecond execution for double-entry balancing engine and ISAM object storage)
proposed_modern_tech_stack.storage_engine: Hybrid: RocksDB / LMDB for high-throughput append-only transaction logs & hierarchical object graph + Embedded DuckDB for analytical OLAP rollups and columnar MIS queries
proposed_modern_tech_stack.ui_runtime: Tauri v2 + Rust backend with SolidJS / React Canvas-rendered virtualized keyboard grid (supports both desktop native app and ultra-fast web client)
proposed_modern_tech_stack.network_and_api: Actix-web / Axum running embedded HTTP/REST/WebSocket server, with Port 9000 XML Emulation Server for 100% backward compatibility with Tally tools
proposed_modern_tech_stack.extensibility_engine: Custom declarative DSL + TypeScript/Wasm runtime mirroring TDL (Report -> Form -> Part -> Line -> Field -> Collection -> Object)

data_layer_design.storage_paradigm: Hierarchical Object Store with immutable Append-Only Transaction Log (Write-Ahead-Log). Every state change emits an immutable event for MCA Audit Trail compliance.
data_layer_design.indexing: B+Tree indices on GUID, MasterId, VoucherNumber, LedgerId, StockItemId, Date, HSN, BillReference, and Full-Text search index for Alt+G Go To Omnibar.

group_attributes: Nature of Group (Assets, Liabilities, Income, Expenses)
Method to allocate when used in purchase invoice (Not Applicable, By Quantity, By Value)

attributes: Check for credit days during entry (Yes/No)
Activate interest calculation (Yes/No, parameters: % rate, style, compound, grace days)
Mailing Details: Name, Address, State, Country, Pincode

TCS Details: Is TCS Applicable, Buyer/Lessee Type, Nature of Goods

native_voucher_types.description: Inter-bank and cash deposit/withdrawal transfers
All outward payments (Cash, Bank, e-Payments)
All inward receipts (Cash, Bank, Cheques, UPI, Cards)
Non-cash adjustments, provisions, depreciation, transfers
Outward supply invoices (Item Invoice, Accounting Invoice, As Voucher)
Inward supply bills (Item Invoice, Accounting Invoice, As Voucher)
Sales returns, trade discount rebates, value reductions
Purchase returns, debit notes to suppliers, rate revisions
Customer order management with scheduled delivery dates
Supplier purchase order booking with tracking numbers
Goods dispatch delivery challan prior to invoice
Goods receipt note (GRN) prior to purchase bill
Goods returned by customer before invoice generation
Goods rejected and sent back to supplier before bill
Inter-godown transfer & Manufacturing BOM transformation
Physical stock audit counts vs book balance adjustments
Provisional transactions auto-reversed on defined dates
Off-the-books memo vouchers for pending approvals
Attendance and production hours/pieces recording
Automated salary computation and pay head accruals

entry_modes: Double Entry Mode: Explicit Dr/Cr or By/To line-by-line
Single Entry Mode: Account header (Bank/Cash) + multiple breakdown lines
Item Invoice Mode: Header party + Inventory Item lines (Qty, Rate, Unit, Discount %, Amount) + Tax ledgers
Accounting Invoice Mode: Header party + Service ledger lines without inventory items
As Voucher Mode: Journal-style debits and credits with bill allocations
voucher_system.voucher_classes: Configurable templates with pre-defined ledgers, automatic tax calculations (CGST, SGST, IGST), and automatic round-off ledgers.

units_of_measure.alternate_units: Configurable conversion rules with loose unit handling (e.g. 1 Bag = 50 Kgs, with independent actual and billed quantities)

inventory_engine.godowns: Hierarchical location storage (Head Warehouse -> Aisle -> Rack -> Bin), inter-godown transfers, transit godowns.
inventory_engine.batch_management: Batch numbers, manufacturing date, expiry date, shelf life tracking, warning/blocking sale of expired batches.
inventory_engine.price_levels: Multiple price levels (Wholesale, Retail, Institutional, Dealer) linked to party ledgers, with date-effective quantity discount slabs.
inventory_engine.bill_of_materials: Multi-level manufacturing recipes: Raw material items + consumption quantities + scrap % + by-products + co-products + additional manufacturing overhead costs allocated by % or value.

features: Multi-registration GSTIN support in single company file
HSN / SAC resolution hierarchy (Company -> Group -> Item -> Ledger -> Voucher line)
Automated Tax splitting: Intra-state -> CGST + SGST/UTGST; Inter-state -> IGST
Cess calculation: Ad-valorem percentage + Specific cess per quantity unit
Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) on unregistered dealers and notified services
E-Way Bill: Automatic generation threshold check (> Rs 50,000), JSON generation, direct NIC GSP API sync
E-Invoicing: Automatic IRN generation (64-char hash), signed QR code rendering, signed invoice JSON, cancellation workflow
GSTR-1 generation (B2B, B2CL, B2CS, CDNR, CDNUR, EXP, AT, ATADJ, EXEMP, HSN, DOCS)
GSTR-3B generation (Outward supplies, Eligible ITC, Ineligible ITC, Values of exempt/nil, Tax payments)
GSTR-2A / GSTR-2B / IMS Auto-reconciliation: 5-way matching engine (Exact, Match with tolerance, Value mismatch, Missing in books, Missing in portal)
Triaging dashboard: Flags uncertain/mismatched transactions with one-click resolution

capabilities: Deduction at credit or payment, whichever is earlier
PAN validation and automated 20% penalty rate for invalid/absent PAN
NSDL TIN-FC compliant e-TDS text file generation (Form 26Q, 27Q, 27EQ)

audit_trail_mca_edit_log.compliance: MCA India Companies Act 2013 audit trail mandate
specifications: Immutable append-only log recording every create, alter, delete, and cancel action
Stores timestamp with millisecond precision, user ID, client IP, action type
Stores complete before-state and after-state field delta
Audit trail feature cannot be disabled in Audit Log edition
Verification and sampling reports for auditors

Deductions from Employees: Employee PF (12%), Employee ESI (0.75%), Professional Tax, TDS/Income Tax
Employer Statutory Contributions: Employer PF (3.67%), EPS (8.33%), EDLI (0.5%), PF Admin (0.5%), Employer ESI (3.25%)
processing_workflow: Auto-generate Payroll Voucher with salary computation engine
Produce Payslips, Attendance Register, Payroll Register, PF ECR text file, ESI Return file, Form 16

features: Auto Bank Reconciliation (BRS) with parsers for 250+ bank formats (MT940, CSV, Excel)
Fuzzy matching engine comparing instrument number, date, amount, and party name
Cheque Management: Cheque book allocation, Cheque Register (Available, Unclear, Cleared, Cancelled, Blank)
Cheque Printing engine with customizable bank cheque dimensions and font positions
e-Payments: Generation of standard bulk payment files (NEFT, RTGS, NACH) and direct bank API integrations
Cash / Cheque Deposit Slips and Payment Advice generation

reporting_and_analytics.drill_down_engine: Universal non-destructive recursion: Pressing Enter on any figure drills into sub-group -> ledger -> monthly summary -> voucher register -> voucher in edit mode.
reports: Balance Sheet (Horizontal T-Format and Vertical Schedule III Division I format)
Profit & Loss Account (Trading Account -> Gross Profit -> Indirect Expenses -> Net Profit)
Cash Flow & Funds Flow Statements (AS-3 / Ind-AS 7 compliant)
Ratio Analysis: Liquidity (Current, Quick), Solvency (Debt-Equity), Profitability (Gross %, Net %, ROCE, RONW), Turnover (Inventory, Debtors, Creditors)
Day Book, Cash/Bank Book, Multi-columnar Ledger Register
Receivables and Payables Aging Analysis (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, >90 days) with bill-by-bill drill down
Stock Summary: Group summary, Item movement analysis, Batch aging, Slow-moving / Dead stock analysis
Exception Reports: Negative Cash, Negative Stock, Overdue Bills, Cancelled Vouchers, Optional Vouchers
